instructions:
Bug: for a number of enemies, the stun bar UI does not visibly fill or change as the enemy takes stun-type damage, yet after enough qualifying hits the enemy does become stunned anyway. Confirmed present on current master and also present in build 12010, so this is not a recent regression.

Affected enemies:
1. All junkdogs except the base junkdog and the bloodhound junkdog
2. All bombots
3. All jungledogs except the normal base jungledog
4. All bosses

Two separate causes appear to be involved and both need to be investigated and fixed:

- Bombots: BombBotEntity.ModifyIncomingInteraction (BombBotEntity.cs, around lines 71-79) strips Damage.Type.Stun from every incoming hit, so their stun bar/buffer can never fill from damage. Any stun they do exhibit currently must be coming from a non-damage source (e.g. a hack or quirk calling Stun() directly) rather than accumulated stun damage. Fix so stun-type damage is no longer stripped and actually accumulates toward their stun bar/threshold, consistent with how base junkdog/jungledog work.

- Junkdog/Jungledog variants (Armored, Spiked) and bosses: prior investigation found the stunBuffer value itself is not overridden per-prefab (Armored/Spiked variants inherit the same stunBuffer=50 as base, so it's not a simple YAML numeric override). Instead there's a preliminary, unconfirmed lead that the stun bar UI wiring is at fault: BotHealthBar.Setup binds the stun bar via GetComponentInParent<IStunComponent>(), which for these variants resolves to an EntityProxy (e.g. Spiked dogs via JunkDogSpikes, Armored dogs via ArmorEntity proxies on PhysicsRig) or to a bubble GameEntity (e.g. Mantis/Ussam bosses) that has no status effects of its own — so the bar reads stunDamage=0 from the wrong component while the actual root entity is the one accumulating stun damage and eventually triggering the stun. This needs to be verified live in the editor (not just from source/prefab YAML), since it has not yet been runtime-confirmed. Bosses specifically have not yet been checked at all and need the same live verification.

Please investigate live in the editor to confirm (or rule out) the BotHealthBar/IStunComponent binding theory for the junkdog/jungledog variants and check whether the same or a similar issue applies to bosses, then implement a fix so that for all the affected enemies listed above, the stun bar visibly fills/updates in step with the stun-type damage that is actually accumulating toward the stun threshold on the entity that gets stunned. Also fix the Bombot stun-damage stripping described above as part of this. Done means: hitting any of the affected enemies with stun-type damage visibly moves their stun bar, and the bar reaching full corresponds with the enemy actually becoming stunned, for junkdogs (except base and bloodhound), jungledogs (except base), bombots, and bosses.
not_done: Live verification of the BotHealthBar/IStunComponent binding theory for Armored/Spiked junkdog and jungledog variants
Stun bar UI fix for all affected enemies
